fields.name: ArgentSeaReminderOptionsValidator.ValidateConfiguration
fields.contract: Validates the current ReminderOptions.MinimumReminderPeriod. A value below 00:00:00 is rejected by throwing OrleansConfigurationException. A non-negative value whose TotalMinutes is below 1 completes validation and emits warning code RSErrorCode.RS_FastReminderInterval.
